recipe:
set -e
x=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/preprint_v2/catalog_processing/xi_scan/xi_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $x
c=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/preprint_v2/covariances/cov_scan/cov_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $c
o=$(mktemp -d)
b="$(python src/workflow/scripts/decision_values.py fiducial_blind blind_a)"
versions=$(python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/catalog_versions.py size_cut applied --comparison)
for ver in $versions; do
  cb=covariance_"$ver"_"$b"_integration
  python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/cosebis_covariance.py \
    --version "$ver" \
    --reporting-binning bins_20 --integration-grid bins_1000 --mode-count n_max_20 \
    --xi-integration "$x/$ver"_xi_minsep=0.5_maxsep=300.0_nbins=1000_npatch=1.txt \
    --cov-integration "$c/$cb/$cb"_processed.txt \
    --out-file "$o/$ver"_"$b"_cosebis_covariance.npz
done
tar czf results/preprint_v2/covariances/cosebis_covariance_sweep.tar.gz -C $o .
